To log in to your Microsoft account safely, please use the official, secure links below. 

### **Official Microsoft Login Links:**

*   **For Personal Accounts** (Outlook, Xbox, Skype, OneDrive, Windows):
    *   👉 **[Sign in to Microsoft Account](https://account.microsoft.com)** (account.microsoft.com)
    *   👉 **[Direct Microsoft Login Page](https://login.live.com)** (login.live.com)
*   **For Work or School Accounts** (Office 365, Azure, Microsoft Teams):
    *   👉 **[Sign in to Office 365 / Work Account](https://login.microsoftonline.com)** (login.microsoftonline.com)

---

### **Having Trouble Signing In?**

*   **Forgot your password?** 
    You can reset it by visiting the official **[Microsoft Password Reset Page](https://account.live.com/password/reset)**.
*   **Forgot your username/email?** 
    You can look it up using the official **[Microsoft Username Recovery Page](https://account.live.com/username/recover)**.
*   **Locked out of your account?** 
    Follow the prompts on the login screen to send a verification code to your backup email or phone number. 

### **🔒 Security Tip:**
Before entering your password, **always** double-check your browser's address bar to ensure the URL begins with `https://` and ends with `microsoft.com`, `live.com`, or `microsoftonline.com`. Never enter your credentials on any other site to protect yourself from phishing attempts.
